name: Central Bank of India
title: Central Bank of India - 532885 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Advances up 18.8% to ₹3.45 lakh crore and CD ratio 73.8%, but Q4 PAT of ₹724 crore was hit by a ₹632 crore one-time DTA charge; ECL transition and treasury drag weigh on FY27 earnings.

triggers.label: Yield on advances 8.21% → 7.78%
triggers.quote: Yield on advances year-on-year basis, it is 8.21%. And in this quarter, it is 7.78%.

triggers.label: Slippage guided below 1% FY27
triggers.quote: for next year, we have given guidance that we are going to keep it less than 1%.

triggers.label: NIM Q4 ex-tax refund ~2.9%
triggers.quote: excluding this item also, the NIM has not been much impacted. I mean it was 2.96% in last quarter. It is around 2.89% or 2.9% in this quarter.

triggers.label: Advances growth 18.76%, guide 14-16%
triggers.quote: Gross advances increased by 18.76% to INR344,516 crores.

guidance.quote: for next year, we have given guidance that we are going to keep it less than 1%.
We have given direction that we are going to remain above 3%.
We have given the guidance of 65%-35% plus/minus 5%
capital budget, it is INR1,442 crores and revenue is INR1,276 crores for current year 2026-27.

red_flags.label: Q4 fresh slippages ₹1,301 cr vs ~₹800 cr avg
red_flags.quote: our slippages are INR1,301 crores as against roughly around INR800 crores on an average every quarter.

red_flags.label: Recoveries from written-off accounts fell QoQ
red_flags.quote: recovery in written of account previous quarter, it was more than INR1000 crores that is INR1062 crores. But this quarter, it is only INR352-odd crores.

red_flags.label: Treasury income collapsed to ₹9 crore
red_flags.quote: this quarter, it is INR9 crores.

red_flags.label: Q4 NIM aided by ₹431 crore tax refund
red_flags.quote: We got a refund of INR431 crores in income tax interest

red_flags.label: Airline lumpy account unresolved
red_flags.quote: That lumpy account actually process is going on.
